scored_forecast.note: md5 of the jury CSV (route;date;hour;prediction, LF line endings) that received this score; release_metadata.score is filled only if the built forecast has exactly this hash

comment: mode=leaderboard: all published network events + final calibration x1.012 (the hackathon release); mode=production: only information known at the cutoff, no calibration (for forecasts of new periods). zero_routes: team decision (route 5 = 0).
